acceptance_oracle: When an existing profile's normalized preferences change through the connected Profile UI/API, one profile-owned SETTING_CHANGED record is committed atomically with the profile update. Its Activity summary is fixed and value-free, persists after reload, and stays invisible to another profile. Creating a profile or saving unchanged preferences emits no setting-change event.
gap_observation: The Activity read model already translated SETTING_CHANGED records to a fixed safe summary, but profile preference writes emitted only PROFILE_SAVED. No production preference mutation generated the required user-facing setting event.
implementation: Store.save_profile compares validated normalized preferences with the prior immutable profile snapshot.
A changed preference set appends a generic SETTING_CHANGED audit record in the same transaction as profile persistence; the payload is empty and contains no preference names or values.
Initial profile creation and repeat saves with unchanged preferences do not emit SETTING_CHANGED.
The event retains normal append-only audit IDs and is profile-scoped; existing Activity readback uses the fixed summary.

test_first.observed: The connected profile PUT succeeded but emitted zero new SETTING_CHANGED timeline events; expected exactly one.
